prompt: Customers opt in to back-in-stock alerts via a storefront button, and the merchant reviews and triggers notifications from an admin panel.

intent.desiredOutcome: Customers opt in to back-in-stock alerts via a storefront button, and the merchant reviews and triggers notifications from an admin panel.
intent.qualityBrief: A solid version captures email, prevents duplicates, shows subscription history clearly, and lets the merchant send test emails before bulk notifications. Key edge cases: handle deleted products gracefully, respect unsubscribe requests, show which products have pending subscribers, and confirm sends to avoid accidental double-notifications. The storefront widget should be lightweight and non-intrusive on mobile.
